positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Responsible for the development and release of the MyVocaliD Android app, enabling users to speak with their custom digital voice
• Designed, built and deployed VocaliD’s suite of enterprise speech synthesis integrations including: HTTPS API, Linux/Android/Windows SDKs, containerized on-premise web-server, and interactive voice response (IVR) 
• Developed a novel DRM system to balance VocaliD’s licensing and user experience objectives
• Built VocaliD’s internal operations portal (web-based UI integrated with scalable AWS infrastructure); worked with users to plan enhancements as demand scaled from a few voice builds per week to dozens a day
• Solved production bottlenecks by automating and distributing neural network training (machine learning) and deployment
• Integrated VocaliD's synthetic voice / deep-fake detection solution with enterprise-class IVR systems
• Deployed continuous integration server to manage deployment of docker images to staging and production environments

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and developed tools to interface with narrow band radar using C# and WPF
• Redesigned re-imaging UI for narrow band radar systems to enable configuration management
• Migrated build software and static code services to new servers
• Collaborated with team members and customers on UI development
• Participated in Agile Scrum stand-ups and sprint planning meetings

positions.title: IT Internship
positions.description:
• Managed configuration and distribution of iPads, and laptops
• Assisted installation of data servers and switches
• Prepared Mac OSX and Windows 7 images
• Preformed user support for teachers and administrators
